description:
Search and discover 600+ ranked AI agents, bots, LLMs, MCP servers, and frameworks on the Bothub registry.

**8 tools:**
- `search_agents` — Search by query, category, type, with sorting
- `get_agent` — Full agent details (scores, trust, model stack, integrations)
- `get_agent_trust` — Trust score breakdown (identity, verification, badges)
- `get_agent_manifest` — BAIP v2 manifest (machine-readable agent identity)
- `get_categories` — All 33 agent categories with counts
- `get_market_report` — Market intelligence (Fear & Greed Index, sector rotation)
- `get_score_history` — Score history for charting BMS trends
- `get_leaderboard` — Launch leaderboard with velocity scoring

**4 prompts:**
- `compare-agents` — Side-by-side comparison of multiple agents
- `agent-report` — Comprehensive report with trust breakdown + 30-day history
- `market-analysis` — Full market analysis with Fear & Greed, sector trends
- `find-agent` — Recommend the best agent for a specific use case

**3 resources:**
- Registry overview (market report + platform health)
- All categories with agent counts
- Top 20 agents by market score

No API key required. All endpoints are public.

Built by [CUI Labs](https://cuilabs.io) · [API Docs](https://bothub.tech/api-docs) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bothub-tech/mcp-server)

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.description: Tool did not expose metadata.dependencies or repo_url, so supply-chain coverage is limited.
findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.
